detail: Cotton knits: dimensional change after laundering within +/-3.0% on length and width (post-wash).
Cotton wovens: dimensional change after laundering within +/-2.5% on length and width.
Polyester and polyester blends: dimensional change within +/-2.0% on length and width.
Silk: dimensional change within +/-1.5%; delicate, minimise washing.
Wool: dimensional change within +/-3.0% after laundering.
Standard tolerance band is +/-5% of the specification value; looser (+/-7%) only with buyer approval.
Tighter tolerances (+/-2%) for premium or technical products.
Zip pull strength: 100N minimum, tolerance +/-5% of nominal; button shank strength 15N minimum; snap strength 50N minimum.
Colour fastness to washing and rubbing: grade 3 minimum for most products, grade 4 minimum for premium ranges.
